title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (October, 2025)
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) is now generally available with platform version 27.0.39966.0 and application 27.0.38460.39974 for cloud, along with updates for earlier waves BC26, BC25, and BC24. The post provides cumulative update information, lifecycle dates, and support policy details for all active and end-of-life versions from BC27 back to BC13.
key_points: BC27 CU00 cloud build is Platform 27.0.39966.0 with Application 27.0.38460.39974; the on-premises build is Platform 27.0.40210.0 with Application 27.0.38460.40242
New customers start on BC27; existing customers are told by email when their update is available
October 2025 updates for older versions: BC26 26.6, BC25 25.12, BC24 24.18
Under the Modern Policy, on-premises 27.x is supported from Oct 1, 2025 to Apr 6, 2027; BC23 and older are listed as end of life

quotes.text: New customers will automatically sign up for Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27).
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies default enrollment behavior for new organizations on the latest release

quotes.text: Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows key improvement in BC25 giving customers control over update timing
